data.narrative: Module 07 completed the operational documentation and runbook suite for the URL shortener service, synthesizing containerization, CI/CD, fail-fast configuration, Prometheus alerting, failure modes, and circuit-breaker resilience into an authoritative service overview and three linear checklist runbooks. During the break exercise, configuration drift was diagnosed where an environment variable rename caused false database outage symptoms; Runbook 1 was updated with a secret-free pre-flight environment key guard. Fresh verification confirmed clean lint, clean build, all 13 Jest suites passing 78 tests, valid fail-fast startup behavior, and explicit boundaries for unexecuted live Docker and PostgreSQL checks.

dimension_scores.observation: Operational documentation captures container inspect, stats, bounded restart, and rollback procedures while respecting non-root runtime boundaries.
dimension_scores.evidence: service-overview.md and runbooks.md document immutable image tags and local rollback commands; docker info verified Docker Desktop 29.9.2 with 0 running containers, correctly marking live container execution checks NOT EXECUTED.

dimension_scores.observation: Continuous integration and documentation maintenance are coupled so operational documents stay synchronized with code releases.
dimension_scores.evidence: Lint exited 0, Nest build exited 0, all 5 Jest groups passed 13 suites and 78 tests, and git diff --check exited 0; PR checklist controls were defined to require runbook updates alongside configuration changes.

dimension_scores.observation: Runbooks provide exact metric queries and log inspection commands correlated with Prometheus alerts and structured JSON logs.
dimension_scores.evidence: Runbooks 2 and 3 map HighErrorRate and HighLatency alerts to bounded http_requests_total, overflow counters, and duration histograms, using request_id log correlation while withholding sensitive payload details.

dimension_scores.observation: Incident runbooks separate process liveness from dependency readiness and prevent false diagnosis under configuration drift.
dimension_scores.evidence: Step 1 pre-flight environment check was implemented to catch renamed variables (e.g., DB_CONNECTION_STRING) before database queries execute, preventing misleading ECONNREFUSED errors and unwarranted container restarts.

dimension_scores.observation: Runbooks enforce strict boundaries between safe cache-read degradation and fail-closed critical mutations.
dimension_scores.evidence: service-overview.md and runbook fix steps document that Redis failures allow safe read-through fallback, BullMQ falls back to database event writes, and PostgreSQL connection failures remain strictly fail-closed.

dimension_scores.observation: Documentation provides copy-pasteable PowerShell checklists with expected healthy/unhealthy outputs, escalation timelines, and reproducible verification evidence.
dimension_scores.evidence: runbooks.md, service-overview.md, and runbook-break-analysis.md provide complete checklists, verified fail-fast outputs, dry-run records, and clear NOT EXECUTED boundaries for unavailable PostgreSQL and HTTP endpoints.

strengths: Linear checklist runbook design provides exact copy-pasteable commands with healthy and unhealthy expected outputs, reducing cognitive load and error risk during 3 AM incidents.
Pre-flight secret-free environment guard detects configuration drift without leaking credentials, preventing false outage attribution.
Comprehensive service overview synthesizes containerization, fail-fast configuration, Prometheus alerting rules, failure modes, and circuit-breaker resilience into a single operational reference.
Strictly separates verified local unit/mocked test evidence from unavailable live Docker, PostgreSQL, and HTTP endpoints.
data.recommendation: Incorporate automated smoke tests into CI to validate runbook commands against configuration schemas, and conduct scheduled operational GameDay drills to prevent documentation drift.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Selected Option A (checklist) to reduce cognitive branching and command errors under pressure, and reinforced it with pre-flight guards to mitigate rigidity against config drift.
Integrated container tags, fail-fast env validation, Prometheus alerts, and graceful degradation boundaries into an authoritative service overview.

concepts_demonstrated.concept: Config drift detection and secret safety
concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Added Step 1 environment key-name check in Runbook 1 that checks has_DATABASE_URL and matching keys without dumping values or leaking connection secrets.
Explicitly distinguished 13 passing Jest test suites and startup fail-fast drills from unexecuted live Docker container checks and offline PostgreSQL port 5432 probes.

teaching_approaches.detail: Demonstrated how an un-guarded process.env.DATABASE_URL lookup produces an undefined connection string and false ECONNREFUSED symptoms during variable renames.
Guided the creation of a secret-free environment key inspection command to validate preconditions before running database session queries.

learning_style_signals: Uses concrete command output and test assertions to separate verified behavior from runtime assumptions.
Uses exact command output and failure-first tests to distinguish local evidence from unobserved live-system behavior.

public_evidence.artifact: Production Readiness Module 07 Service Overview & Operational Runbooks
public_evidence.student_action: Authored service overview and incident runbooks for database connection failures, 5xx spikes, and high latency, hardened with a secret-free pre-flight environment key guard.
public_evidence.technical_detail: docs/service-overview.md and progress/production-readiness/module-07/runbooks.md specify exact PowerShell 5.1 commands, Prometheus alert thresholds, 10/15/20-minute escalation paths, and safe live process inspection.
public_evidence.proof: Lint and Nest build exited 0; 13 Jest suites passed 78 tests; startup fail-fast verified missing DATABASE_URL (exit 1), invalid NODE_ENV (exit 1), and redacted production errors; docker info and TCP 5432 checks recorded with explicit NOT EXECUTED live boundaries.
public_evidence.ability: Designs, verifies, and hardens operational documentation and incident runbooks for distributed systems.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates production operational maturity by providing actionable, tested runbooks that mitigate config drift and prevent catastrophic remediation mistakes.
